<!--
  A section with a heading and the questions. Axes: layout (accordion: native disclosures that open without
  script; chat: question and answer as alternating bubbles), columns (1, 2), search mode (none, field: a search
  field above; the page filters by `search.query`), filter mode (none, categories: tabs above; the page filters
  by `filter.category`), density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Faq, FaqTab, FaqSearch, FaqFilter } from "./faq-list.types";

export type FaqListProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  items: Faq[];
  search?: FaqSearch;
  filter?: FaqFilter;
  layout?: "accordion" | "chat";
  cols?: "1" | "2";
  multiple?: boolean;
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Disclosure from "../primitives/disclosure/disclosure.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Summary from "../primitives/disclosure/summary.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import SearchField from "../components/search-field.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import Switcher from "../components/switcher.vue";
import SwitcherItem from "../components/switcher-item.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  items,
  search,
  filter,
  layout = "accordion",
  cols = "1",
  multiple = false,
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<FaqListProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ query: [text: string], category: [value: string] }>();
const inCategory = computed(() => items.filter((i) => !filter?.category || i["category"] === filter?.category));
const shown = computed(() =>
  inCategory.value.filter((i) => !search?.query || String(i["question"]).toLowerCase().includes(String(search?.query).toLowerCase()))
);
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :measure="(((layout as string) === 'chat') ? '2xl' : 'default')"
  >
    <SearchField v-if="(search?.mode === 'field')"
      :label="(search?.label ?? '')"
      :placeholder="search?.label"
      :value="(search?.query ?? '')"
      @value="(arg: string) => emit('query', arg)"
    />
    <Switcher v-if="(filter?.mode === 'categories')" :label="filter?.label">
      <SwitcherItem
        v-for="tab in filter?.tabs"
        :key="tab.id"
        :active="(tab.value === filter?.category)"
        @click="() => emit('category', tab.value)"
      >
        {{ tab.title }}
      </SwitcherItem>
    </Switcher>
    <Stack v-if="((layout as string) === 'chat')" gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="faq">
      <Stack v-for="item in shown" :key="item.id" gap="2" align="stretch" data-testid="faq-item">
        <Block tag="div" class="ml-auto max-w-xs sm:max-w-md rounded bg-primary px-4 py-4 text-primary-foreground">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ item.question }}
          </Text>
        </Block>
        <Block tag="div" class="mr-auto max-w-xs sm:max-w-md rounded bg-muted px-4 py-4">
          <Text size="sm">
            {{ item.answer }}
          </Text>
        </Block>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
    <Grid v-else :cols="(((cols as string) === '2') ? '1-2' : '1')" class="items-start gap-x-8" data-testid="faq">
      <Disclosure v-for="item in shown" :key="item.id"
        variant="item"
        :name="(multiple ? undefined : tpl('{0}-faq', (id ?? 'faq')))"
        data-testid="faq-item"
      >
        <Summary variant="item">
          {{ item.question }}
        </Summary>
        <Text size="sm" class="pb-4 text-muted-foreground">
          {{ item.answer }}
        </Text>
      </Disclosure>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
